trace.question: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.
trace.evidence: June 2013 refers to '201306'; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month;

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE substr(replace(t.Date, '-', ''), 1, 6) = '201306'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE substr(replace(t.Date, '-', ''), 1, 6) = '201306'
trace.answer: There are no gas stations with transactions in June 2013, so no countries are returned.
